page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan. Left page: one column of running text with Greek and italic words; running head at top; page number 24 at top left. Right page: narrow text at the right edge with marginal notes and fragments (partly cut off); treated as notes in the right margin.

main_text.p: Samária, &c. Sic βασίλεια as ἡ regina à βα-σιλεύς.

79. Substantiva in εἶα orta à verbis in έω habent a longum, ideoque sunt προπάροξύτονα, ut βασιλεία as ἡ regnum à βασιλεύω regno vel fum rex. in pl. nom. βασιλεῖαι ὧν αἱ regna. ἐλευθερία as ἡ servitus, à ἐλευθερόω servio. προφήτεια as ἡ prophetia, à προφητεύω propheto. in pl. num. προφητείαι ὧν αἱ prophetiæ, Herod. Ἰσχυρῶς προφητηῶς.
80. Substantiva in ία orta ab Adj. in & habent a breve, ut ab εὔνοος benevolus, est εὔνοια as ἡ benevolentia.
81. Substantiva in ωσύνη funt penacuta. ut ἀδικοσύνη ἡς ἡ justitia. σωφροσύνη temperantia. ἀσχημοσύνη ἡς ἡ gestuum turpitudo ἀ σχῆμα τῆς τὸ gestus, Rom.1.27.
82. Diphthongi ἀι & ῳ finales in Nominibus & Adverbiis circumflectuntur, ut ὦ βασιλεύ, ὦ rex. πανταχοῦ ubiq. At ἰδού ecce ad differentiam. a.z.med.imperat. ἰδού.

83 Substantiva in μαι & μων orta à prima persona præteriti passivi nunquam sunt ὀξύτονα, ut κέκμαι τῆς τὸ res judicata, à κέκμαι. ῥῆμα τῆς τὸ verbum, ab ἐῤῥημαι Attice εἰρημαι, abjecto augmento & mutato αι in α. λέλειμμα τῶν τὸ reliquiæ Roman.11. v.5. à 1.prt.pass. λέλειμμαι relictus fui, verbi λείπω linquo. abjecto λε & mutato αι in α. γνώμων οὗ ὁ gnomon, stylus horas indicans, ab ἐγνω-
Note: several notes on the right page are cut off and only partly legible; see the notes section.

page.notes: Right page is a narrow, damaged margin of Greek and Latin notes (numbers 84, 85, 86, 87 and fragments such as "præt.pass.", "Luc.9.14", "Rom.1.5"), too cut off to transcribe reliably; they are not reproduced. Many Greek words in the main text are doubtful and marked only by their general shape; accents may be inexact. The final line of the left page is partly cut at the bottom.
